headline: A 1996 executive order from President Clinton about educational technology and children's access to it in schools.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with getting educational technology to children so that all of them have a chance to use it. No summary was provided, so the specific actions it orders federal agencies to take are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The title says the order aims to make educational technology an opportunity for all children.
The order's focus on educational technology suggests it involves technology used in schools, but the details are not given.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 17, 1996; the title does not state a separate start date.
